finish-time.purpose: the finish time on a result row. Proportional figures, `--text-1`, never the accent.

date-day.purpose: the day on a race card's date tile (the tile's `::first-line`).

item.purpose: race names on cards and rows, empty and error headings, the sheet's heading.

body.purpose: base text, the search field, sheet checkbox labels and fields.

button.purpose: primary and secondary buttons, sheet buttons.

meta.purpose: location, counts ("**7** upcoming races", the number in 600), the sort label, result dates, state body text, the tertiary "Clear all filters". The List/Map segments and the sort value use 15px at 600. Meta shares body's size and stays apart from it by color (`--text-2`).

proof.purpose: the proof line; the month and year under the date day (line-height 1.2 there).

label.purpose: format chips and active filter chips. The markup keeps the format's own name ("Half marathon").

tab-label.purpose: tab labels and map pin labels.

shadows.name: shadow-sheet
shadows.purpose: What floats over content: the Filters sheet and the floating tab bar (The Float Rule). Cards are flat.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Button background and press; 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: dur-sheet
motion.purpose: Filters sheet slide and scrim fade; 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: dur-pulse
motion.purpose: One breath of the skeleton pulse (C6); still under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: dur-spin
motion.purpose: One turn of the busy spinner (G26); keeps turning under reduced motion (HIG: a still indicator reads as stalled).

breakpoints.name: screen
breakpoints.purpose: iPhone logical width; single layout, no breakpoints.

components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview:
A graphite stand with one amber light on it. The ground is dark but never black, and it gets lighter in small, even steps from the tab bar up to the raised controls. Type and contrast carry the energy, not color: the screen title and the key numbers (finish time, date day) sit in a heavy display face, and everything else is a quiet text face in sentence case. The amber accent appears once or twice per screen, only where you can act or where you are.

The product is an iPhone-shaped app (390px wide) in Operate mode: athletes scan a calendar of races and pull up their own results as proof. So hierarchy beats decoration. On a race card the date and the place lead and the photo is a black-and-white band, not a poster. On a result row the finish time is the loudest thing. The proof line under it says where the result comes from ("Self-reported · via results.hyrox.com"). It never stamps the result as verified.

What the screens refuse: aggressive "energy" red, pure black with one hot accent, one heavy condensed face for everything, no radius at all, per-format colors, success-green on results, and the artifact pages' values (`#0b0c0e`, the `#ff4d2e` family).
keyCharacteristics: Dark with depth: five background levels between L* 4.99 and 19.67, all near-neutral (C* ≤ 3.87).
One scarce accent, sodium amber `#F5B649`: the primary action and the current tab, and nothing else.
Two faces: Schibsted Grotesk 800 for the title and key numbers, Hanken Grotesk 400/600 for everything else.

Small radii: 4px inside, 6px outside in content. Bar chrome is native: the floating tab bar is a capsule, controls inside bars are concentric capsules (C7), the Filters sheet takes the sheet radius (38px [?]), and Profile initials are the one circle.

Flat content, glass chrome: the tab bar, the controls bar, the top bar, the action bar and the Filters sheet are translucent graphite with blur (C1). Cards never are. Shadows belong to what floats: the sheet and the tab bar.
Neutral metadata: format chips, filter chips, map pins, the saved confirmation and every pressed state stay gray.
Black-and-white photos, 3:1, inset in the race card.
Solar bold icons, drawn as CSS masks in the color of their text.

rules.name: The Two Lights Rule
rules.body: The amber appears at most twice on a screen: the current tab, plus the one primary action if the screen has one. Race browse at rest has only the tab. Log result has no tab bar and no other amber, so its Save, in the top bar, is the screen's one primary and takes amber text, like a native bar button. Every other active state stays neutral: the active filter chip is an outline, the pressed segment is `--bg-3`, a checked checkbox is `--control-tint` (Text 1, C4), the focus ring is `--text-1`.

rules.name: The Stated, Not Stamped Rule
rules.body: No green, no check icon and no "verified" mark on any result or anywhere on Results list. The saved confirmation is `--bg-1` with a gray save glyph.

rules.name: The Depth of Dark Rule
rules.body: Every background level has L* between 4.5 and 20 and C* ≤ 6, and each level is at least 1.5 L* above the one below it. `#000` and `#0B0C0E` are out.

rules.name: The Three Shouts Rule
rules.body: The display face is used for the screen title, the finish time and the date day, and nowhere else. Race names, chips, buttons, tabs and meta are the text face.

rules.name: The Name Stays Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is `text-transform` only. The format name in the markup never changes.

rules.name: The Float Rule
rules.body: Only what floats casts a shadow: the sheet and the floating tab bar. Everything else is a tone step.

rules.name: The Glass Rule (C1, step 3b)
rules.body: Bars and the sheet are glass (see Colors → Glass); content never is. A card, a row, a chip or a field stays a flat tone.

dos: **Do** keep the amber to the one primary button and the current tab: at most two uses per screen.
**Do** make the finish time the loudest thing on a result row, through Schibsted 800 at 32px in `--text-1`, not through color.
**Do** lead a race card with the date tile (day 30px over month and year 13px) beside the name, chip and place.
**Do** show every photo in black and white (`--photo-filter`), inset at 3:1 with a 4px radius.
**Do** state proof as its own 13px `--text-2` line with one link icon: "Self-reported · via \<domain\>".
**Do** step a secondary action up or down so the screen keeps exactly one filled button.
**Do** take every value from `ui/kit.css`. Pages and the kit's classes hold no raw values.
**Do** draw icons as Solar bold masks in the color of their text: 15px in meta, 18px in buttons and fields, 26px in the tab bar.
**Do** keep 44px targets, a 2px `--text-1` focus ring, and 0ms motion under `prefers-reduced-motion` (skeletons still; only the busy spinner keeps turning).
**Do** check text on glass against the worst case behind it, not against the glass's own tint.
donts: **Don't** put the amber on a finish time, a chip, a filter chip, a count, a link, a focus ring, an icon in content, a status, or the map.
**Don't** use green, a check icon or the word "verified" on a result or on Results list.
**Don't** give formats their own colors. Every format chip is the same neutral chip.
**Don't** use pure `#000`, `#0B0C0E`, the `#ff4d2e` family, `src/style.css` or the wireframe grays.
**Don't** use aggressive "energy" red. Errors are soft coral `#EE8B84`, on the icon only.
**Don't** set race names, chips, buttons or tabs in the display face, or use one heavy condensed face for everything.
**Don't** drop the radius to 0, or round content into pills (pills belong to bar chrome only).
**Don't** give cards a shadow, a border at rest, or glass.
**Don't** use `--line`, `--field-line` or `--field-line-sheet` as a fill (the sheet's grabber is a drawn 4px line, the one exception).
**Don't** let invalid and focus look alike: coral inside for invalid, white outside for focus.
**Don't** use tabular figures on finish times: Schibsted spaces the colons wide ("24 : 36").
